description: This file defines the MaintenanceDao class within the OrangeHRM system, part of the Maintenance plugin's Data Access Objects. It extends BaseDao and provides a method for extracting data based on employee number and optional join conditions.

classes.name: MaintenanceDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for maintenance-related database interactions within the OrangeHRM system, providing method to extract data based on employee number.

methods.name: extractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Extracts data from a specified table based on employee number, with optional join conditions.
